build.beforeDevCommand: bun run gen:icons && bun run --cwd packages/web dev -- --clearScreen false
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run gen:icons && bun run --cwd packages/web build

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first coding agent workbench with secretless microVMs
bundle.longDescription: Isolade runs coding agents in sealed, throwaway microVMs on your own machine, so an agent can work unattended without reaching your files or your real secrets.
